blocks.tamil_translation: scolded me, the Prophet ﷺ would say, “Leave him alone. (Do not say anything.) For when a matter (whether a shortcoming or otherwise) has been decreed (by Allah), it will surely happen.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ:قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:كُلُّ شَيْءٍ بِقَدَرٍ حَتَّي الْعَجْزُ وَالْكَيْسُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب كل شيء بقدر رقم:٦٧٥١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Every matter has been written in Taqdir (destiny). Everything, including (a person's) inability (lack of understanding) and cleverness, happens according to destiny,” said the Prophet ﷺ. Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَي اللهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ، اِحْرِصْ عَلَي مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللهِ وَلَا تَعْجِزْ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَيْءٌ فَلَا تَقُلْ: لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا وَلكِنْ قُلْ قَدَرُ اللهِ وَمَاشَاءَ فَعَلَ، فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “The strong Mu'min is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak Mu'min, yet there is good in every (Mu'min). Be eager for what benefits you, seek the help of Allah (in it), and do not lose heart. When a loss befalls you, do not say, “If I had done this, things would have turned out like this!” Rather say, “(This) is a matter Allah has decreed (and decided). He did what He willed.” For the word “if I had done this’ (or words like it) opens the door to the works
